session_summary: Blue title bar: 'OO Bottom, Spike and Channel Bull Trend'. An outside outside bottom at 4395 and buy climax to 4419 leads back into a triangle; a failed breakout below the triangle with a lower low double bottom launches the spike and channel bull trend, with a bear trap at 4412 and a minor wedge topping the close at 4422.
